_rules: deptId is the JOIN KEY. Subdomains get renamed; the ledger uses prose names; only the id is stable.
ledgerName null = no IMPORT_LEDGER section B row. That is a FINDING for a LIVE tenant, not a defect in this file.
platformCounter is a PLATFORM REVISION ID, not our version. Equal counters mean same config generation. Versions come from ingest_tenant_export.ps1 only.
UNLOCATED ledger rows are listed in _unlocated -- a ledger row with no tenant is as much a gap as a tenant with no ledger row.
ledgerVersion is what IMPORT_LEDGER section B CLAIMS, transcribed once. It is a CLAIM, not a measurement -- ingest_tenant_versions.ps1 compares it against what the tenant reports.

tenants._bundlesMeasured: 2026-09-18T18:28:47Z -- FROM THE DEPLOY RECORD, not a live reading: usx_deploy_73046844870_2026-09-18T18-28-46-749Z_CLICKED.json, verdict CLICKED, guardsFailed [], dryRun false, modal target 73046844870, payload SC_SLED v1.15 [ENTITIES, SC_SLED, RMS], 917903 -> 909802 normalised and read back at 909802. An import REPLACES the bundle set (measured twice on this tenant), so SHAREDQ_PROBE is gone. platformCounter is null because a deploy record cannot know it -- only the live bundle table carries it, and inventing one would be the guessing this row already got burned for twice. THIS IS THE CLASS OF EVIDENCE emit_import_job's Get-LatestDeployState now consumes automatically: a successful import used to silently invalidate the NEXT job, because expectBundlesNow came from a hand-maintained row that only moved when someone was asked for a reading. usx-sc-sled was refused three times in one hour on 2026-09-18 and the third was self-inflicted -- Rob: 'still sloppy'. A deploy newer than the last reading now supersedes it. STILL NOT PROOF OF LANDING (a CLICKED verdict is not proof; verify_tenant_import is) -- it sets a pre-flight EXPECTATION for a guard that re-reads the live page, never a claim about what is installed. PRIOR READING 2026-09-18T18:20:11Z -- MEASURED off the LIVE bundle table (button 1), after the SHAREDQ_PROBE import. Reads [ENTITIES 614, SHAREDQ_PROBE 1]: SC_SLED and RMS are GONE, which is the documented behaviour (an import REPLACES the bundle set) and not a fault. This read exists because the v1.15 import job was REFUSED by its own pre-flight -- the job had been cut against the 09-17 reading below, which four imports had since invalidated. The guard was right and the job file was stale; the fix is a fresh reading, never an inference. ENTITIES counter moved 605 -> 614 across those imports, still opaque and still not our version. PRIOR READING 2026-09-17T17:52:29Z -- MEASURED off the LIVE bundle table (button 1), 51 seconds AFTER the v1.10 restore import. [ENTITIES 605, SC_SLED 6, RMS 70] -- the coherent three are BACK and MULTILINE_TEST (row cb0jf0o) IS GONE. Paired with deploy record usx_deploy_73046844870_2026-09-17T17-51-38-457Z_CLICKED.json (verdict CLICKED, guardsFailed [], payload SC_SLED v1.10 [ENTITIES,SC_SLED,RMS], 1156505 -> 1146418 bytes normalised and read back at the same size, modal target 73046844870 confirmed), that is proof-of-landing to the fullest extent this tenant permits. TWO PRIOR PIECES OF MY OWN REASONING ARE CORRECTED BY THIS READ, and both were recorded here as if settled. (1) A ROW ID IS NOT AN INSTANCE KEY. SC_SLED came back as ojke025 and RMS as 0ydnyze -- THE SAME IDs they carried on 09-16 -- despite both rows being ABSENT from the table at 17:35:32Z. An ID therefore survives delete-and-recreate, so the 09-16 note's inference ("the row IDs are UNCHANGED ... so the three bundles were REPLACED IN PLACE, not added alongside") never distinguished replace-in-place from delete-then-recreate. The 17:35 DISAPPEARANCE still proves an import REMOVES bundles the payload omits; what it cannot do is prove anything from ID stability. (2) THE COUNTER GOES DOWN: ENTITIES 602 (v1.7) -> 607 (2 probe imports) -> 605 (v1.10). A monotonic revision counter cannot decrease, so platformCounter is NOT a revision generation -- it is opaque, and any reading of the form "it increments once per import" is void. SC_SLED 5 -> 6 is consistent with +1 but ENTITIES refutes the rule, so the pattern is coincidence until something explains it. STILL TRUE: platformCounter is NEVER our version -- ours rides in the bundle description -- and this tenant's Export JSON returns NOTHING (CLICKED-BUT-NO-JSON), so verify_tenant_import correctly FAILs here with "no CURRENT config on disk". That is the tool refusing to infer. Bundle NAMES plus a paired deploy record are the only evidence this tenant can yield.
